title: Finite complete rewriting systems for graphs of free groups with applications to free-by-cyclic, one-relator, and three-manifold groups
summary: We prove that any finite graph of finitely generated free groups admits a finite complete rewriting system after possibly taking a free product with a free group of rank two. As a corollary we obtain that any HNN-extension of a finitely generated free group over a finitely generated subgroup admits a finite complete rewriting system. We then use this result, and other tools, to give partial solutions to several fundamental open problems about finite complete rewriting systems for hyperbolic, one-relator, fully residually free, and three-manifold groups.
